findings.description: The attached inline policy grants ec2:*, s3:*, lambda:*, and cloudwatch:* on Resource "*", so this user can enumerate, read, alter, and delete essentially all compute, storage, serverless, and logging resources in the account. A leaked deploy credential (an access key is created for this user) yields near-account-wide compromise rather than limited deploy rights.

A static IAM access key pair is issued for the svc_deploy user with no rotation mechanism or expiry; combined with the wildcard user policy, compromise of this single credential grants broad administrative access to the account indefinitely.

The svc_deploy user has no MFA device requirement and cannot be protected by one, since a programmatic access key bypasses MFA entirely; there is no policy condition (e.g., aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent) restricting use of these permissions.
